root_cause: M5GFX M5UnitGLASS uses a custom STM32 register protocol (REG_INDEX first byte: 0x00/0x10/0x90/0xB0/0xC0/0xD0/0xFE etc.), not SSD1309 control-byte framing (0x00/0x40). The old model treated the first byte as glass_control and ignored 0xFE/0x90/0xB0 transactions, so commands/data stayed 0. Patch 0157 implements the custom protocol and QOM pages.
boundaries: Official GlassUnit/M5Unified composition now produces model-visible command/data/page transactions; transparent OLED optics, 2 buttons and buzzer semantics are NOT RUN (static fixtures/no asserted behavior).
0x3D conflicts with lcd/oled/mini-oled/glass2; one display per bus.
Guest drawing is a synthetic controller-level path, not a physical transparent-panel optical validation.
